senses.gloss:
वेन् वेन्, † वेण् वेण्, i. 1, Par. Ātm.
 1. † To go.
 2. † To know.
 3. † To reflect.
 4. † To discern.
 5. † To hold or take a musical instrument.
 6. † To play on a musical instrument.
 7. † To take.
 8. To praise (ved.).
 9. To love, Chr. 292, 8 = Rigv. i. 86, 8.
 --Cf. αἰνέω, αἴνη.
